verses.text: salaatul lazii fii kulli shahrin wa fii safar
hamaanii halaa maahin mahal habsa was safar
falaahi bikawnii habda rabbii khadiimahu
hajiibun bihi lii jaada mughnin hanin nafar
radiitu hanil mawlaa wa han khayri khalqihi
halayhi salaamaa man lahu ubtu biz zafar
salaatun wa tasliimun mahal bishri sarmadan
halaa man bihi muksii mahal amni wal bashar
firaariya bil mukhtaari min qablu qaada lii
mukuusan wa tabshiran ladal jinni wal bashar
rafahtu shukuuran bahda hamdin mukhalladin
libaaqin mahaa durril lazii haazahul qadar
salaatul lazii adhuuhu habdan lahu bihi
halaa man bihi lii qaada safwan bilaa kadar
fasaahatu khayril khalqi abdat qasaa-idii
wa kawnii bihaa habdan khadiiman lahu zahar
rabihtu rabaahan lam yakun qattu misluhu
bifadlil lazii kawnii habiiban lahush tahar
salaatul lazii lii qaada kawnii khaliilahu
halaa man bihi lii tayyabal badwa wal hadar
futuuhaatu rabbil harshi anqat mahaa-ibii
bijaahil lazii baahat bihi man halaw mudar
rabaahiya fii ikhdaami khayril waraa badaa
wa fii kulli shahrin zaydu ribhii wa fii safar
